reviews.review_description: RAW Power and Lighting were very efficient and called me immediately to provide a quote. Whilst I was not looking for the cheapest system they ended up providing me with a top quality set up at a very affordable price. They were very helpful from the start and the whole thing was finished within three weeks. Very courteous guys doing the install and everything was left tidy at the end. They were more than happy to explain how it all works and at this stage I couldn't be happier. I would highly recommend them to others.

Ryan was great with communication and information needed for us to decide on the right system.  Installation went smoothly.  Guys cleaned up well.  Nic organised everything for us - so very stress free!  Would totally recommend RAW Power and Lighting.  In fact, we are getting further electrical work soon with this company.
Simple quotation to understand. Answered questions well. Timely. Think I’ll be happy with the system when it’s finally up and running.
Raw power and lighting were great. Easy to deal with, efficient and pleasant to deal with. Happy with my solar.

RAW Power and Lighting did an outstanding job installing my solar system. The workmanship was top quality, with every detail finished to a really high standard. What impressed me just as much was their flexibility — not only did they take care of the solar installation, but they were also happy to tackle a few other jobs around the house at the same time, which made the whole process so much easier for me.The team was professional, reliable, and great to deal with from start to finish. I’d highly recommend RAW Power and Lighting to anyone looking for skilled electricians who go above and beyond for their customers.

Initial sales service and helping me work out what I wanted was excellent - I got exactly what I wanted from that process with a lot of advice and support along the way for a very competitive price. Very knowledgableInstallation was... not great.* I had serious amounts of concrete dust/debris left inside the house, ceiling cavity and outside from installing the brackets on my concrete tile roof. Only partially remedied when they vacuumed out the easily accessible third of my roof space - but then left the rest.* I have some split rafters from them not pre-drilling before driving pretty large screws into them for the brackets.* I had a couple of cracked tiles discovered underneath some of the solar panels (on a freshly restored roof) that neither the solar installer or roofer was willing to take responsibility for. But the installer did want to charge me for a full day's work to come and remove/replace 2 panels so I could get those tiles replaced. They are on the Gold Coast, I am in Toowoomba. No allowances made for their potential culpability until I fought it.I gave up and some items remain un-raised and unaddressed. It was exhausting having to fight them on everything to get anything fixed. Very poor customer service in that regard.Electrically I have no idea. I am unqualified and could not tell you if what I got is up to scratch. To a layman, it looks good.Grid connection and setup for monitoring was excellent. I didn't have to do a thing there.All in all - I really hope that my system stands the test of time and just keeps working for me so that I don't have to deal with the installer again.

Raw’s customer rep, Ryan was amazing at keeping me informed and taking me through all the options, despite me having a million questions. I never felt pressured to sign on with them like other companies, and as they have a small team I knew who was going to be responsible for the install. When talking with others about when they had solar installed they’d often say that they had no after installation follow up. But Raw took time to call me back on a Saturday morning to see how things were going and give me an update.

Quoting and install was all quick, efficient, genuine and user friendly. There was an issue with the hot water timer and they came back the same day I called to let them know. The service to ensure it was fixed was incredible.

Ryan was a font of knowledge and the conversation was easy to follow, very informative, and I felt no pressure.I was very pleased with the quote.  I had gathered four quotes in all and Raw Power and Lighting was the 2nd cheapest, but I felt most comfortable going with them.Nic and his team arrived at the agreed time and were professional and tidy.  The hybrid inverter set-up is neat and tidy.  Nic showed me how to use the app (very easy) to view how much power was being generated by the panels/ how much power was being used by the household/ how much power was going back to the grid etc.Everything with the energy supplier was organised for me by Raw.  I don't think the whole process could have been any easier.
Did not have to worry about anything installation install grid if I had a question they would answer it polite nice people The sales person was factual helpful would definitely use them again.

Ryan at sales was very responsive and competitive. They are a smaller local firm- so more ownership on the service itself. I did not need too much detailed information on operating - but i would imagine they would offer that at installation for other customers.
Very easy quoting process and very helpful before and after install.

The quoting process was super prompt after enquiry through solar quotes. Got two recommended installers, Raw Power surely stand out from being prompt to have a chat to find out our needs and although they are not the cheapest. But they gave good recommendations although I did give the brands I wanted after doing my own research. Ryan who was involved in quoting process was very prompt and friendly. I like the fact that he actually takes my calls or questions even outside office hours (as it was hard for me to take calls during office hours).One key thing that also stands out was that he highlighted that Nic the owner, is the installer and makes sure everything goes well, and that really gives me assurance when the boss is out and doing the actual installation. Nic arrived on installation day early, very polite and explains the process and what's going to happen. They helped to connect everything at the end, make sure everything was cleaned up well and done properly, to the process of teaching you about the app and what it means. I have to say I'm extremely pleased with the outcome and whole process. Highly recommend Raw Power & Lighting, and thank you Nic and your team member for your hard work installing the solar on such a hot day!

I recently had solar panels installed on my property in Queensland. This was done by Raw Power and Electrical, and i wanted to record here that the entire experience exceeded my expectations. Initially, I used SolarQuotes to narrow down my options—needless to say, this website is truly a one-stop shop for customers. I received about five quotes and picked one which was incidentally not Raw Power and Lighting. However, in the rush and by mistake, I signed a contract with my second choice, Raw Power and Lighting.Understandably upset by this error, I discussed with Raw Power about the episode. Listening to my concerns Raw Power obliged to match (even better ) my first choice quote. I made this request as waiting for refunds would be a hassle and time-consuming. Though initially apprehensive, I took a decision to proceed with Raw Power.From that point onward, Nic and Louise were incredibly cooperative and kept me informed of every development. Their consistent communication and updates helped ease my worries and gradually built my confidence in their service. In hindsight, I realised I had made a wise decision.Throughout the process, Raw Power was attentive , explained their plans and listened to my suggestions when deciding of the split of panels to the East and West of the roof. Live images were sent to me whilst the installation was going on. The entire installation from signing of contract , approval and to completion  took a couple of weeks only. Work was done as scheduled and the quality of work was incredibly outstanding.The professionalism and comprehensive documentation provided all contributed to a seamless experience. Not to mention, the pricing was extremely competitive. What began as a mistake turned into a winning decision and an exceptional experience.They were prompt to respond to emails and queries, even after- work hours. I wholeheartedly recommend Raw Power and Lighting to anyone considering solar installation. Take my word. Excellent job Nic and Louise - thank you.

The team were proactive, reaching out a few times, but not invasive or annoying. They provided clear and helpful advice.In terms of the cost, they were bang in the middle of quotes I recieved, hence the 4 star value rating. I'm sure you could get cheaper, but I would't recommend it. We chose good hardware but not the best, hence 4 stars here too.In terms of service they were polite, efficient and appeared to know what they were doing! The system is running beautifully, and they have ben easy to contact for ongoing support when needed.Overall highly recommmended!

The sales process was refreshingly transparent, the team at Raw Power and Lighting were straight up with me about the current state of technology, and what equipment was suitable for my property (without trying to just sell units). The installers were extremely professional and knew their stuff, and they handled everything. The whole process was surprisingly easy. Can recommend to any/all! And always good to support a small local family business.

Kept us informed if running late due to traffic or waiting to pick up of panels.The only company that actually got on the roof to have a look b4 quoting.Family run and owned that lived locally to us.Explained the ins and outs of the system especially the hybrid inverter and cleaning of the panels.

Ryan was very prompt and professional and caring of my circumstances. Very attentive to my questions and queries. Nothing was too much.The installation went to plan with Nick being punctual and polite.Louise and Nick were very professional with emails and detailed information regarding the grid connection.

From initial contact to installation and even an additional service added after the installation the whole process was simple and fuss free.I was ill through parts of this customer journey and felt the right amount of help, recontact when scheduled and patience with our decision as I was under gge weather.This was not the cheapest quote.It felt right from the moment Ryan and I started a dialog.Would certainly recommend and am very happy with my decision.Thanks Ryan , Thanks Nick.Regards,AllanQLD 4285

Nic from RAW Power went out of his way to listen to our requirements and then applied his industry experience to providing us with a range of options that suited our needs. I was safe, punctual and professional during the installation. The work site was left clean neat and tidy, and the system we have now just works. Nic is easy to talk to, was willing to provide advice. He installed our preferred brand of panel and offered plenty of options. RAW Power was just easy to do business with. Compared to the other quotes we received RAW Power also offered good value to money too.

My experience with Raw Power and Lightning was nothing short of exceptional. From the initial inquiry to the final installation, their team displayed unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction. Unlike other companies, they prioritized understanding my needs over pushing sales tactics, providing transparent information and guidance throughout.What truly impressed me was their willingness to go above and beyond. Not only did they track down the specific panel type I requested, but they also ensured competitive pricing and delivered a flawless installation. As a pleasant surprise, they even had time to install an outdoor switch for me.Raw Power and Lightning have also streamlined the financing process by partnering with Plenti, making it effortless for clients seeking solar finance. Taking my time to select the right installer paid off, as they surpassed my expectations.Their professionalism combined with a personalized touch made me feel valued, not just another customer. They adhered to the scheduled installation date, arrived punctually, worked diligently, and maintained the utmost care for my roof. Moreover, they left the premises spotless, showcasing their attention to detail.The follow-up they offer demonstrates their commitment to ensuring continued satisfaction. If you're in search of a trustworthy solar installer, I highly recommend giving Raw Power and Lightning a try. Their blend of professionalism and personalized service sets them apart in the industry. Choosing them was undoubtedly the right decision for me.

Got multiple quotes and while not the cheapest we went with Nic and the crew from Raw Power, because they were the only ones to include a mandatory meter box move in the total quote. It gave us clarity on exactly what we would be paying. We also never felt pushed or hassled in any way.They were very accommodating with the install as well. We had a roof repair and paint booked in, and Raw kindly worked with us to install the mounts and wiring first then come back many weeks later to install the panels and inverter after the roof was painted.Beautiful install as well, everything neat, tidy and well finished.System itself is running well (aside from some grid voltage issues in the street from time to time). Blown away by how efficient and high producing this system is during very cloudy and even rainy days, compared to similar sized systems in the area. Installed additional optimisers are clearly working extremely well!
AAA rated installation. Great system.Fitters arrived on time,worked hard and left a tidy work site.Follow up enquires to Raw solved any quickly.

The quote was in person with different options discussed and explanations easy to understand.  Installation was seamless.  It did cost a bit extra for additional optimisers.  System seems to be working efficiently with no problems, and producing significant power according to the iSolarCloud app.  Very happy thus far.
Efficient, and communicated well. I would highly recommend Nic and his team

Nic from Raw electrical & lighting was the first of the 3 quotes to call and came out the next day. we received the other 2 quotes by the end of the following week and decided to go with Raw as the system he offered fitted in with our needs and our budget.The solar system was installed Thursday and we couldn't be happier, all work was carried out very professionally and we were shown how to track the output on my mobile phone the whole process was seamless.

The whole process from quotes to installation was easy.SolarQuotes were very helpful and put me on to 3 installers.We went with Nic from Raw Power.  Great service, product and installation .  Nothing was to hard.  The cost was quoted upfront and there were no hidden costs as all.  Nic even help organise a green loan through Plenti.

Very happy with raw power and lighting. Install went smoothly, they discussed where to mount inverter, conduits to be the least obtrusive.System works great, 25 year warranty, can't go wrong. Nic was happy to answer questions and the install team were all punctual, got the job done in about 6 hours (26 panels), left everything tidy.

I found Raw Power & Lighting professional from our initial contact right through the whole process.  Their communication throughout was very good.  The salesman was professional and quite happy to answer my multitude of questions about the product and process involved for installation.  I found the quote from RAW very detailed compared to other company quotes.  The installation went well, the installers were punctual, professionally attired, did the job they came to do and cleaned up after themselves.  RAW organised the paperwork needed to start the grid connection processes and followed up with a couple of queries I had post installation.  Very happy customer!  So happy, I have since had RAW back to help with another project at our home.
hole accidentally through drilled wall not repaired properly by contractor

All you recommended companies provided fast, efficient, helpful and competitive quotes, with good follow-up. It was quite hard to choose between them. In the end we chose Raw Power. He came to our house, which was an advantage, although not essential. He was very competiive and persuaded us that the make of panels and the inverter were of good quality, depite not being the most highly recommended by you. The (outsourced) installation experience was excellent. Overall we wre surprised how painless and inexpensive it was to  get a good-sized solar sytem.

Prior to discovering this website I had another company quote me $10,000 (after the 2020 grant) for a very average system and low grade inverter thank's to Fynn's graph. I could tell this was not good but to be sure I started ringing companies and found that I was being quoted way too high. Furthermore, I went ahead and signed up elsewhere for quotes. The best 3 quotes I recieved were from Fynn's website and they were the best quality inverters and panels of any other dealer. 11 quotes later from multiple places I decided on Raw Power and Lightning for their exceptional quote, service, kind and patient explanation of process and their quality of product. I'm now a proud Solar owner and these guys really went above and beyond. Cannot recommend them enough, I already have to another friend, and will continue to send people to Fynn's website. You cannot go wrong. I was nearly taken for a very expensive ride over 10 years and they were very convincing. Now I am getting a way better deal all around and no one is taking advantage of me. Thank you Finn!

Quoting process - fast, next day at site and thorough including aerial photographing with a drone.Answered queries and made some adjustments to quote.Best price and credible technical quote.Installation - prompt scheduling, skillful and neat.Provided follow up of documentation and liaised with energy supplier for installation of digital meter.
Raw were the only company to take the time to come to my house and talk face to face and actually view the property. Great communication and very professional installers.

From accessing quotes to final installation and follow up couldn’t fault anythingThe salesperson was informative and provided advice and comparative information about brands of panelsThe installers were prompt very personable and helpful and very today tidy,cleaning up thoroughly after install. They also provided info about the system including helping to install the remote appOverall a very easy process

Very happy with the offering from Raw Power and Lighting. I had done a fair amount of research but Dan and Nic were extremely responsive and patient with my own process.Dan was able to organise my Trina and Sungrow installation of 6.6kw to add to my existing 1.5kw legacy system. Getting the smart meter and hot water switch were logical additions to the package. Original lead time to install was around 4-5 weeks, but I was able to get installed sooner which was great to make use of Feb sun.Certified installation team were efficient and did a good job. Able to answer my extra questions about the hot water switch and the Sungrow Monitoring App to make sure I understood how it all worked.Dan and Nic were responsive post installation when I asked about some messages on the App and subsequent settings update on the Inverter. Thanks again Dan, Nic and install team!Nick Burger

Raw Power & Lighting came to see our roof and house which provided us with peace of mind that they understood what was required, and provided helpful insights that went beyond just the solar panels (e.g.  directing us to websites that would help us seek the best energy deal).  They also responded really quickly to our questions and could fit us in before Christmas.The installation went really well - they were on time and did a tidy job.They also helped complete the necessary paperwork to organise the grid connection after the install - that was really helpful.

Came out to see our house in person prior to quoting (the only that did) and provided quick responses to my questions at all hours. Install went very smoothly despite wet weather and tricky terracotta roof. System seems to be working great so far. Thank guys!

I obtained the detailers of three installers from solarquotes. One rang me on the phone and from that provided a quote. One did not contact me at all. Dan from Raw Power and Lighting rang me the same day and organised a site visit. During the visit he was able to provide an excellent description of the options and expected performance. He also answered several questions by email in the week or two following the visit whilst I was deciding which provider to choose.Once I paid the deposit things moved very quickly with the system installed within a week. The installation was completed in one day and we were left with a working system at the end of the day. There were a couple of problems with the configuration of the system monitoring (not effecting power production) which were resolved in the week or so after the installation.Overall I am very happy. In the couple of weeks since the installation we have been generating more power than we are consuming, and the monitoring software from Solaredge is fantastic.

Fully recommend!Dan came to the house and provided in depth info about the inverters and panels suitable for our place. Made it super clear how it was all going to work and also helped explain what type of energy plan we would need for maximum results.Installation happened incredibly quickly and the installers did a terrific job. Really tidy work.Dan even came by a few weeks later and shot drone footage of our house. That was awesome, I'd never seen our place from the air and he sent me through the high-res pics. Above and beyond! The panels on the roof look fantastic and perfectly symmetrical, incredible work.We couldn't be happier choosing Raw Power & Lighting.Cheers to Dan, Nic and the team! Stellar job!

Dan took his time to sit with me to go through the options (compared to one of the other companies that pretty much showed up, gave me a brochure and left), and kept following things up right through and past the installation process. The sparkies on the day were extremely professional and friendly. Would happily recommend.
Everything was so easy. Answered all questions quickly and communication was great every step of the way.

Extremely happy with this service. From quote to installation, the team had exceptional knowledge and customer service. I felt completely confident with my choice in system for my needs. I would highly recommend getting a quote from Raw Power and Lighting.

The entire process from start to finish was amazing. I had an obligation free quote provided in a short amount of time, installation was fast and efficient. The tradesman were friendly, efficient, tidy and punctual as well as very informative.They also helped me with all the grant paperwork and organised the grid connection after the install plus checked up on my latest bill recently to make sure the whole package had worked as per anticipated savings etc.
